method: Research ingestion registry for high-value importer/distributor/merchant websites. It records how trade material may be used and which claims require stronger authority. This is not a web crawler embedded in the game runtime; it is a provenance contract for bulk research passes.

fieldPolicy.sensoryPolicy: Producer/importer tasting notes are observations about a wine or release, never universal cultivar/site constants.

sources.name: Skurnik Wines & Spirits
caveats: trade copy can summarize producer claims
appellation display is not a legal product specification

sources.name: European Cellars
caveats: producer portfolio facts may span vintages
old-vine ranges must retain producer/site context

sources.name: The Rare Wine Co.
caveats: merchant historical narratives require corroboration before becoming historical fact

sources.name: Kermit Lynch Wine Merchant
caveats: legacy PDFs may be old snapshots
historical sheet values must not overwrite current producer data

sources.name: Bowler Wine
caveats: portfolio/product-line labels are trade metadata, not origin law

conflictPolicy.sameVintageSameField: retain every observation, rank by evidence channel, and open a conflict if normalized values disagree materially
conflictPolicy.differentVintage: version by vintage; never call normal vintage change an error
conflictPolicy.undatedVsDated: dated record wins for that vintage/date but the undated record remains a producer-level observation
conflictPolicy.legalConflict: quarantine trade claim and defer to current regulator/product specification
conflictPolicy.cultivarConflict: quarantine synonym/identity claim and defer to VIVC/national genetic or registration evidence
